# Shedding new light on the origins of olfactory neurons

## Authors

- Tanya T Whitfield<sup>1</sup> †

### Affiliations

1. MRC Centre for Developmental and Biomedical Genetics, Department of Biomedical Science University of Sheffield Sheffield United Kingdom t.whitfield@sheffield.ac.uk

† Corresponding author

## Abstract

Sensory neurons in the nose of the zebrafish are derived from both neural crest cells and placode cells.

claims.claim: Sensory neurons in the nose of the zebrafish are derived from neural crest cells.
claims.source_text: Sensory neurons in the nose of the zebrafish are derived from both neural crest cells and placode cells.
claims.evidence_reasoning: This claim is stated in the abstract as a factual finding about zebrafish olfactory neuron origins, implying it is supported by experimental data or observations, though the specific data is not shown in this excerpt.

claims.claim: Sensory neurons in the nose of the zebrafish are derived from placode cells.
claims.source_text: Sensory neurons in the nose of the zebrafish are derived from both neural crest cells and placode cells.
claims.evidence_reasoning: This claim is stated in the abstract as a factual finding about zebrafish olfactory neuron origins, implying it is supported by experimental data or observations, though the specific data is not shown in this excerpt.

claims.claim: Olfactory neurons have dual developmental origins.
claims.source_text: Sensory neurons in the nose of the zebrafish are derived from both neural crest cells and placode cells.
claims.evidence_reasoning: This claim is logically inferred from the statement that sensory neurons in the nose are derived from two distinct cell types (neural crest cells and placode cells), implying dual origins for olfactory neurons.

results.result: The authors report that zebrafish olfactory sensory neurons have dual developmental origins, arising from both neural crest cells and placode cells. This challenges the traditional view that olfactory neurons derive exclusively from placodal tissue.
results.result_reasoning: While claims C1-C3 state this finding as fact, the provided excerpt contains only the abstract with no experimental data, methodology, controls, or statistical analysis visible. Without access to lineage tracing methods, sample sizes, quantification of contribution from each cell type, appropriate controls, or validation experiments, the evidence supporting this dual origin claim cannot be evaluated. The claims reference DATA and INFERENCE as evidence types, but no actual data is presented in the excerpt for critical assessment.
